description: This Java source file defines a custom ArrayAdapter for ListItemObject, used to populate a ListView with custom views, manage stable IDs for list items, and includes a utility method for creating circular cropped bitmaps.

classes.name: CustomArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for ListItemObject that manages stable IDs and provides a custom view for list items.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at the given position.

methods.name: updateStableIds
methods.description: Updates the mapping of ListItemObject to stable IDs.

methods.name: addStableIdForDataAtPosition
methods.description: Adds a new stable ID for the data item at the specified position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter supports stable IDs.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or updates the view for a list item at the specified position.

methods.name: getCroppedBitmap
methods.description: Returns a circular cropped version of the provided bitmap.
